U.S. airman whose Sonic Boom chase is for a dead friend.

How Guile connects

  • Faction: World Warriors — Guile is the military World Warrior chasing M. Bison.
  • Character: M. Bison — Guile hunts M. Bison for Charlie Nash's death.

What is Guile?

Guile is the flat-top World Warrior who hunts M. Bison for the death of his friend Charlie Nash, fighting with Sonic Boom and Flash Kick on the military circuit.

Key threads lead to World Warriors and M. Bison.
